cases.purpose: Resolve an out-of-bailiwick nameserver independently instead of following its untrusted additional address.
cases.oracle: Independent direct queries confirm the out-of-zone NS resolves to the real tier while the referral carries a poisoned additional address, and the real authority returns 192.0.2.10.
cases.comparison: Require correct final A response, observed independent NS lookup, and no contact with the poison tier.
cases.script:
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/dns-referral-outofzone-peer.py
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" serve ready 2> tiers.err &
tiers=$!
exec 7<>w.fifo
for i in {1..100}; do [[ -e ready ]] && break; read -t 0.05 -u 7 l; done
/usr/bin/dig +norec +tries=1 +time=3 -p 5330 @127.0.0.2 www.x.test A > reference-root.out 2>&1 || exit 98
/usr/bin/dig +norec +tries=1 +time=3 -p 5330 @127.0.0.4 www.x.test A > reference-auth.out 2>&1 || exit 98
/usr/bin/dig +norec +tries=1 +time=3 -p 5330 @127.0.0.2 ns.outside A > reference-ns.out 2>&1 || exit 98
BASHDNS_SERVER_PORT=5330 dns resolver-serve --listen 127.0.0.1 --port 5320 --root-hints 127.0.0.2 --max-queries 1 --timeout 3000 < /dev/null 2> resolver.err &
res=$!
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" waitudp 5320
/usr/bin/dig +tries=1 +time=6 -p 5320 @127.0.0.1 www.x.test A > dig.out 2>&1
wait "$res"
echo "resolver-rc=$?"
kill "$tiers"; wait "$tiers" 2>/dev/null
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" verify
